title: Synthetic magnetic emulsion fixture
text: SYNTHETIC SOFTWARE FIXTURE. These statements and measurements are invented. An iron oxide-chitosan composite stabilized a sunflower oil-in-water emulsion. Emulsification occurred at pH 5.2. Mean droplet diameter was 2.6 um. The emulsion remained stable for 36 hours. Droplets showed magnetic attraction. The encapsulated model dye released 41% in 8 hours.

title: Synthetic unstable emulsion fixture
text: SYNTHETIC SOFTWARE FIXTURE. These statements and measurements are invented. A chitosan-alginate composite stabilized an emulsion containing olive oil. Preparation occurred at pH 6.8. Mean droplet size was 4.1 um. Phase separation was observed after 12 hours. No cargo loading or external-field experiment was performed.

title: Synthetic particle-versus-droplet size fixture
text: SYNTHETIC SOFTWARE FIXTURE. These statements and measurements are invented. Silica particles stabilized a liquid paraffin emulsion at pH 7.0. The nanoparticle diameter was 90 nm. Emulsion droplet dimensions and stability were not measured. No magnetic experiment was performed.

title: Synthetic missing-information fixture
text: SYNTHETIC SOFTWARE FIXTURE. This passage is invented. An unnamed material was used to form an emulsion. Its composition, preparation conditions, dimensions, stability, external-field behaviour and cargo measurements were not reported.
